result_details.question: What is the CRS scheme administered by BIS, primarily applied to laptops, mobile phones, and IT equipment?
result_details.explanation: CRS stands for Compulsory Registration Scheme, managed by BIS for electronics and IT goods notified by MeitY.

result_details.question: What is the single online portal of BIS that provides end-to-end digital services for standards formulation and certification?
result_details.explanation: Manakonline (www.manakonline.in) is the comprehensive online platform for all BIS e-governance services.

result_details.question: What is the Sanskrit motto inscribed in the BIS logo?
result_details.explanation: The BIS motto is 'मानक: पथप्रदर्शक:' which translates to 'Standards Lead the Way'.

result_details.question: What are the three mandatory marks found on hallmarked gold jewellery in India today?
result_details.explanation: Hallmarked gold jewellery contains: 1) BIS Logo, 2) Purity in Karat and Fineness (e.g. 22K916), and 3) 6-digit HUID code.

result_details.question: Which Ministry is the administrative ministry governing the Bureau of Indian Standards?
result_details.explanation: BIS operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India.

result_details.question: What does 'HUID' stand for in the context of mandatory gold jewellery hallmarking in India?
result_details.explanation: HUID stands for Hallmark Unique Identification, a unique 6-digit alphanumeric code assigned to each hallmarked jewellery piece.

result_details.question: How many Regional Offices does the Bureau of Indian Standards have across India?
result_details.explanation: BIS has 5 Regional Offices: Northern (Chandigarh), Central (Ghaziabad), Eastern (Kolkata), Southern (Chennai), and Western (Mumbai).

result_details.question: Which laboratory is the central and apex testing laboratory operated directly by BIS?
result_details.explanation: The Central Laboratory of BIS is located at Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, equipped with state-of-the-art testing facilities.

result_details.question: BIS was formerly known as which organization established in 1947?
result_details.explanation: BIS was established through the BIS Act, taking over the functions of the Indian Standards Institution (ISI) founded on 6 January 1947.

result_details.question: What penalty can be imposed under the BIS Act 2016 for unauthorized use of the standard ISI mark?
result_details.explanation: Under the BIS Act 2016, misuse of the Standard Mark can lead to imprisonment up to two years and heavy fines up to 5 lakh rupees.

result_details.question: Gold jewellery marked with '22K916' indicates what purity percentage of gold?
result_details.explanation: 22 Karat gold corresponds to 916 fineness, which means 91.6% pure gold.

result_details.question: What does a 'QCO' issued by the Government of India in conjunction with BIS stand for?
result_details.explanation: Quality Control Orders (QCOs) make compliance with relevant Indian Standards and BIS certification mandatory for specified products.

result_details.question: What is the primary objective of the 'Know Your Standards' facility on the BIS portal?
result_details.explanation: 'Know Your Standards' provides free access to read all Indian Standards online for public knowledge and transparency.

result_details.question: Which Indian Standard specifies the specifications and safety requirements for Packaged Drinking Water?
result_details.explanation: IS 14543 specifies the requirements for packaged drinking water (other than packaged natural mineral water).

result_details.question: Which Indian Standard specifies the safety and performance requirements for Two-Wheeler Protective Helmets?
result_details.explanation: IS 4151 covers protective helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles in India.

result_details.question: What is the initial validity period of a standard Product Certification license granted by BIS?
result_details.explanation: A BIS Product Certification license is typically granted for an initial period of 1 to 2 years, subject to periodic renewal and surveillance.

result_details.question: Which official mobile application has been launched by BIS for consumers to verify ISI mark, Hallmarking, and register complaints?
result_details.explanation: The 'BIS Care App' allows consumers to verify ISI marks, Hallmarking, CRS registration, and lodge quality complaints.

result_details.question: Under the BIS Act 2016, who serves ex-officio as the President of the Bureau of Indian Standards?
result_details.explanation: The Union Minister in-charge of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution is the President of BIS.

result_details.question: Under BIS regulations, which of the following items is mandatory to have the ISI mark before being sold in India?
result_details.explanation: Packaged drinking water and natural mineral water are under mandatory BIS certification (QCO) and cannot be sold without the ISI mark.

result_details.question: What is the initiative by BIS to establish student clubs in colleges and schools to promote quality consciousness?
result_details.explanation: BIS establishes 'Standards Clubs' in educational institutions to nurture quality consciousness and standards literacy among students.

result_details.question: On which date is 'World Standards Day' celebrated across the globe each year?
result_details.explanation: World Standards Day is celebrated internationally on 14 October to honor the collaborative efforts of standardization experts.

result_details.question: Which international body responsible for global electro-technical standards does BIS represent India in?
result_details.explanation: BIS represents India as the National Committee in the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC).

result_details.question: Which Indian Standard specifies the quality parameters for Drinking Water (Potable Water)?
result_details.explanation: IS 10500 is the Indian Standard for Drinking Water specifications in India.

result_details.question: What is the standard mark issued by BIS for industrial and consumer goods in India?
result_details.explanation: The ISI mark is the certified conformity mark for industrial goods certified by BIS under Product Certification Schemes.

result_details.question: What is the full form of BIS?
result_details.explanation: BIS stands for Bureau of Indian Standards, the National Standards Body of India.

result_details.question: Which certification mark is issued by BIS for products that meet quality standards along with specified environmental criteria?
result_details.explanation: The ECO Mark scheme was instituted by the Government of India and is administered by BIS for environment-friendly products.

result_details.question: What is the Indian Standard code of practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete (widely studied by Civil Engineers)?
result_details.explanation: IS 456 (IS 456:2000) is the code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete.

result_details.question: What does the National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS) established by BIS do?
result_details.explanation: NITS (located in Noida) is the apex training institute of BIS providing training in standardization, quality management, and testing.

result_details.question: Where is the headquarters of the Bureau of Indian Standards located?
result_details.explanation: BIS headquarters is located at Manak Bhavan, 9 Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi.

result_details.question: What is the Indian Standard code for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures?
result_details.explanation: IS 1893 provides criteria for earthquake resistant design of structures in India.
